BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE VIVEK JAIN  ON THE 6 th OF JUNE, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 23934 of 2025  DEVENDRA SINGH  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH  Appearance:
 Shri Akram Khan - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Sachet Udenia - GA for the State

ORDER This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in relation to FIR/Crime No.77/2025 registered at Police Station - Lateri, District Vidisha for the offence punishable under Section 420/34 of IPC.
2.

It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is a customer of Ashirwad Micro Finance Ltd. Company, Lateri and had taken a gold loan by pledging his gold to the said finance company.

entities.text: Ashirwad Micro Finance Ltd. Company, Lateri
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Lateron there was some internal audit in the said finance company and the gold ornaments pledged by various customers were found to be spurious or substandard quality and in this manner the gold pledged by the present applicant was found to be substandard to the tune of Rs.69,280/-.

It is argued that the present applicant can be actually said to be victim in the matter because the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11689 2 MCRC-23934-2025 gold after being pledged was in the possession of the officers of the finance company and officers of the finance company have not been made accused in the matter.
The gold was pledged by him after due scrutiny of purity and weighed by the valuer of the company.
On this ground it is prayed to grant anticipatory bail.
3. Per Contra , learned counsel for the State opposed the application on the basis of material available in the case diary.

4. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case diary,
without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant- Devendra Singh be released on bail upon his furnishing a bail bond in Devendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19470262/
1 the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer/Arresting Officer of the Police Station concerned.
5.

entities.text: Devendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
It is further directed that the applicant shall attend the police station once every month till the completion of investigation.
